purpose: Cut bounded subtractive features directly into observed existing rigid static UC GLB rectangular-prism meshes, including rotated/translated stock through a proven local source frame, while preserving exact supported material factors and revalidating topology and published GLB geometry.

properties.source_path: existing ordinary .glb creation outside protected live machine body
properties.path: distinct target .glb path outside protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed axm.mesh-precision-cutter/v0.2 recipe for axis-aligned stock, or axm.mesh-precision-cutter/v0.3 recipe with world-space axis_vector matched to a proven oriented source frame
properties.expected_source_sha256: optional exact lowercase SHA-256 binding, with optional sha256: prefix

contains: exact source GLB SHA-256 and source byte count
source closed edge-topology evidence before cutting
v0.3 right-handed orthonormal source-frame axes and frame digest for rotated stock
cut recipe digest bound to exact source digest and source frame
output closed edge-topology evidence before publication

relationships: reads actual existing GLB triangles through UC's static geometry decoder before calculating a cut
reuses UC seam-weld topology evidence before and after surgery
v0.3 derives an orthonormal local frame from the observed eight box corners instead of assuming world-axis alignment
v0.3 binds an explicit world-space axis vector to exactly one proven source-frame axis before cutting
reuses the v0.1 cutter geometry constructors for supported cut shapes
reuses the existing deterministic surface-to-GLB publisher and validator
keeps source bytes separate from the new output and refuses in-place cutting
limitations: v0.3 extends the existing-mesh path to one rigid static closed consistently oriented rectangular-prism primitive under arbitrary rigid rotation/translation. General arbitrary-mesh boolean surgery remains unavailable.
v0.3 cut axes must align with one proven source-frame axis; arbitrary diagonal cuts relative to the stock are rejected rather than approximated.

Only round through-holes and open box notches are supported. Multiple primitives/components, skins, animation, morphs, UVs, textures, tangents, vertex colours, joints and other extra vertex attributes remain rejected rather than silently discarded.
Supported PBR colour/emissive factors must be exactly representable by the existing 8-bit colour surface grammar; unsupported material features are rejected.
Output from one cut is not yet accepted as arbitrary input to another general cut; chaining beyond the proven rectangular-prism source family remains a future gate.
Edge-manifold topology is checked, but self-intersection, visual quality, structural strength, real manufacturing behavior and host-engine import are not proven.

truth.basis: The exact source bytes, seam topology, measured source frame, frame digest, cut axis binding, cut parameters, output topology, output digest and unsupported boundaries are explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the existing source, output path, cut world-axis vector, location, shape, dimensions, kerf and replacement decision; the machine does not invent unsupported free-angle geometry.

continuity.basis: The source is read-only, in-place mutation is rejected, output publication reuses UC atomic GLB behavior, and protected machine-body paths remain unavailable.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The cutter rejects unsupported source/material state, proves closed source topology plus an orthonormal box frame before subtraction, binds the requested axis to that frame, then proves closed output topology and published GLB structure.
